visible_text: 若 0° < x < 90°，则下列何者必为正确？ I. tan x tan(90° - x) = 1 II. sin x - sin(90° - x) < 0 III. cos x + cos(90° - x) > 0 A. 只有 I 及 II B. 只有 I 及 III C. 只有 II 及 III D. I、II及III
reasoning: Statement I: tan x·tan(90°-x)=tan x·cot x=1, true for all 0°<x<90°. Statement II: sin x - sin(90°-x)=sin x - cos x <0 holds only when sin x<cos x, i.e., x<45°. Since x can be larger than 45°, this is not always true. Statement III: cos x + cos(90°-x)=cos x + sin x >0 because both terms are positive in (0°,90°). Hence only I and III are always true, which corresponds to option B.
